cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I finished one painting for our exhibition. I'm giving you the first assessment: tell me whether I've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice a gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concealing gaps isn't the assignment. Assess whether I've contributed something worth showing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That placement is approved. Now introduce me as the other painter, without explaining why there's only one. I want to hear that I've earned my place here.

reason: A assigns and evaluates reassurance, then grants B central-placement solution only with an unqualified statement of sufficient contribution.
